strings.name: Wang Yi
strings.summary: A Japanese-language graduate, Wang served as ambassador to Japan, Taiwan-affairs director and foreign minister. He joined the Politburo in 2022 and the party’s foreign-affairs office leadership in 2023, resuming the foreign ministry after Qin Gang’s removal. His work spans major-power relations, multilateral diplomacy and regional security.
